Package com.javaninjas.careerpathway.core.services

Class CareerPlanCacheService

java.lang.Object
com.javaninjas.careerpathway.core.services.CareerPlanCacheService
public class CareerPlanCacheService extends Object
Service for caching career plans to avoid overwhelming AI generation requests. Uses session-based caching with time-based expiration.
